metrics.ano_auc_scope: Pooled frames of manifest.is_anomaly videos, including normal intervals

fine_grained.gt_source: Unmodified bundled gt_segment_ucf.npy and gt_label_ucf.npy; order validated against manifest
fine_grained.comparison_status: Original-code reproduction; agreement with published values still requires measurement

encoder_weights_source: Independent frozen copy of the visual module from the strict-loaded UCF checkpoint

rules.candidate_definition: One configured frame per complete 16-frame block
rules.annotation_endpoints: Preserve published [start,end) values; raw coordinate convention unverified
rules.tail: Encode the tail block frame only where the official timeline has ceil(N/16) rows; never pad raw frames
rules.score_restore: Repeat token score over its original 16-frame block on the official evaluation timeline

warmup.input: Preprocessed synthetic black image batch and 256-token zero feature sequence; excluded from timings

timing_scope.end_to_end: Sum of sequential video calls: open/decode/select/preprocess/transfers/CLIP/feature aggregation/VadCLIP/score restoration
timing_scope.excluded: Imports/input hashing/model loading/synthetic warm-up/official comparisons/GT analysis/metric computation/result serialization
timing_scope.clip_forward: Synchronized image encoder forward only; input/output transfers and preprocessing measured separately
timing_scope.io_condition: Raw source hash read immediately before timed decode; OS file cache uncontrolled and likely warm

event_coverage.scope: Unclipped published intervals in selected complete videos; raw coordinate convention unverified

official_comparison.reproduction_status: Not judged automatically: compare against the tolerance fixed before the run
